children: Femto Technologies Inc. now holds 51% of I-Rat Technologies after paying US$250K cash for an additional 11% interest. It also reduced the amount payable for an original 30% subscription from US$1.0M to US$750K.
Femto now holds 51% of I-Rat Technologies
Majority ownership gives Femto control of the AI software company, increasing its exposure to the business.
Paid US$250K cash for an additional 11%
The cash purchase price was negotiated, not determined by a business valuator.
Reduced original 30% payment from US$1.0M to US$750K
The revised amount lowers Femto's payment obligation by US$250K.

This is a follow-on ownership step under a share purchase agreement signed earlier this year, expanding Femto's position in an AI research software company. Further evidence of I-Rat's commercial traction or financial contribution would be needed to establish a larger catalyst.
